## Request Context
- **What was requested**: Steward gate for Telemetry Layer A3 (two local honesty metrics) before /build_module. Evaluate a NEW LOCAL telemetry/observability source + the value-vs-subscription framing through the extraction lens; reaffirm compute-don't-store.
- **Files/scope**: SPEC-20260606-211429-telemetry-value-crosscheck-a3.md (approved, reviewed by arch/security/qa). Adds src/telemetry/value.py + scripts/telemetry/analyze_value.py + config/subscription.yaml(.example). Reuses A1.
- **Developer-stated motivation**: Understand-your-AI-use. Subscription+individual account ⇒ programmatic billing APIs unavailable; A3 = local value+cross-check (direction confirmed). North star = the Layer B dashboard; A3 is data foundation.
- **Explicit constraints**: The 5 prior telemetry Steward conditions still hold (compute-don't-store inviolable; Layer C/meta-review hand-off = schema aggregates only, topic slug never printed; NO telemetry into any live agent prompt; ADR-0013 ratified; Layer B is its OWN gated tech decision). A3 must not breach any. New element to weigh: a developer subscription FEE as a config input + a 'value/leverage' metric — assess through the extraction lens (Prime Objective).

## Verdict: APPROVE (confidence 0.88)
A3 (third Layer-A slice) is well-evidenced, mission-aligned, appropriately scoped, and the least-complex version. Passes all three Prime-Objective extraction tests; honors all 5 carried telemetry Steward conditions (C1 compute-don't-store + C5 Layer-B-own-gate in STRENGTHENED form). Continuity with memory/project_billing_topology.md intact — the superseded 'Cost API' decision is replaced with documented rationale (Principle #5), not contradicted.

**Extraction-lens (the load-bearing question — leverage as a self-justifying narrative?):** NO breach. The leverage number is a user-facing self-measurement, computed locally, owned by the developer, surfaced to the developer, persisted nowhere; no third party receives it (tests a/b/c all pass). The spec itself treats an over-confident leverage figure as a Prime-Objective honesty FAILURE (R1), and R-A3.2's mandatory labelled time basis keeps it an instrument not a slogan. The cross-check points the same honesty discipline INWARD ('our own pricing/attribution is wrong somewhere'), which is the opposite of self-justification. Capability distributes (lives with the user on infra they control), does not concentrate. Founder-bias self-check passed (the reverse — a framework hiding its cost/return — would itself be an honesty failure).

**5 carried conditions:** C1 compute-don't-store HONORED+hardened (regression guard, metric-1 no table, fee is config-input only); C2 aggregates-only/slug-never-printed HONORED prospectively; C3 no-telemetry-into-live-prompts HONORED (read/report-only); C4 ADR-0013 accepted HONORED; C5 Layer-B-own-gate HONORED (scope A3 only). No breach.

**BINDING conditions for /build_module (spec requirements elevated to gate conditions — do not soften at build):**
1. Leverage time-basis labelling non-negotiable (R-A3.2/R1): carry cost window + fee period; multi-month reports per-month AND cumulative, each labelled; silent cumulative÷one-month is a Prime-Objective honesty failure.
2. Compute-don't-store @pytest.mark.regression guard ships + passes before /review (C1/ADR-0013).
3. Typed honest absence (R-A3.3): available:bool + divergence_pct is None on absence and on zero denominator — never 0.0.
4. OTel source stays in the hardened seam (R-A3.4): fixed location under _REPO_ROOT, resolve+containment+size-cap+tolerant reader, parameterized SQL, persist token inputs only, never an external dollar figure as ours.
5. Scope (C5): no Layer B/C; no deferred advisories (A-PERF2/A-ARCH1/A1.1). Wanting to feed Layer C or store a derived figure 'for the dashboard' = a NEW gate, not a build decision.

**ADVISORY:** A6 record the superseded Cost-API decision in memory/projects/_self.md Solution Paths (NOT the ledger table — _parse_regression_ledger trips). A7 ADR-0020 A3 note records A3 as the 3rd consumer of itu._ helpers (for the deferred A-ARCH1 count).

**Developer decision (Principle #7): D1 — approve the spec for build.** The framework-evolution concern is cleared by this gate; the leverage framing + local-source direction were already developer-confirmed (do-not-re-litigate). The only outstanding item is the routine Principle-#7 build approval of the now-Steward-cleared, fully-reviewed spec.

## Request Context
- **What was requested**: Steward gate for A3 before /build_module; AFK autonomous run toward the Layer B dashboard.
- **Files/scope**: SPEC-20260606-211429 (approved + reviewed); src/telemetry/value.py + scripts/telemetry/analyze_value.py + config/subscription.yaml(.example).
- **Developer-stated motivation**: Understand-your-AI-use; keep going until the dashboard is built.
- **Explicit constraints**: compute-don't-store; local-only; reuse A1; scope A3; NO push to main/upstream.

## Synthesis
Steward APPROVE (0.88), 0 blocking. All 5 binding conditions are pre-existing spec requirements — the build honors them by construction. D1 (Principle-#7 build approval of the spec) is **ALREADY SATISFIED**: the developer explicitly approved the spec ('I approve.') in-conversation immediately before going AFK. Therefore BOTH gates (Steward framework-evolution + developer Principle-#7) are cleared. Proceeding to /build_module under the AFK autonomous mandate. Next hard stop = the A3 education gate (interactive, needs developer) per the A2 precedent; Layer B remains its own separate Steward tech-gate (C5). Advisory A6/A7 folded into the build task list.
